text:
Maria: routing team -> proposal: add session-affinity header to improve KV cache reuse for multi-turn chat. header: `X-Redwood-Session: <session-id>` and a commit flag `X-Redwood-Session-Commit: true|false`.
Raj: not a wire-breaking change, but semantics: if commit=true the router should try to pin requests to the same backend (to preserve KV). if capacity unavailable we either fallback or return an error depending on client intent.
Olivia: from Py SDK side: we already let callers pass extra headers, but we should add a first-class API. proposal: `client.chat.start_session(affinity='none'|'optional'|'required')` that sets header + maps retry behavior. also add clear docs + changelog note.
Kai: TS SDK: +1. API shape for TS: `const s = client.sessions.create({affinity: 'optional'})` and it should translate to `X-Redwood-Session` and `X-Redwood-Session-Commit` when appropriate. please make it opt-in; we cannot silently change routing for existing users.
Thao: Console implications: add a per-route toggle (Enable session affinity) with tooltip: "Prefer keeping requests for the same session on one worker to increase KV cache hits. May increase resource lock time." If enabled, show per-session metrics: cache-hit %, average locked duration, and a small timeline view for active pinned sessions.
Zane: rollout suggestion: 1) server accepts header but ignores commit flag (noop) so we can test header churn; 2) ship SDK opt-in flag; 3) enable commit-by-default behind a tenant feature-flag for a small set of customers; 4) promote to GA after we see stable cache-hit improvements and no latency regressions. target: 3 sprints with telemetry gates.
Olivia: telemetry: we need sampled request-level field so we can break down benefits. propose `session_affinity=committed|fallback|none` in telemetry events and a derived metric `session_kv_hit_pct` per model+route. also emit `session_lock_failed` counts when commit requested but unavailable.
Raj: agree. also add trace annotations when we pin a session: `session.pinned=true` with backend id (hashed) for debug (PII-free). set sampling low for high-volume routes.
Kai: compatibility: if client requests `required` and the router cannot guarantee pinning, server should return 409 with body explaining "session affinity required but capacity unavailable; retry with affinity=optional or try later". if `optional` server should fallback silently and emit telemetry `fallback`.
Maria: migration note for integrations: mark `route_hint` usage that relied on ad-hoc stickiness with a deprecation notice. provide a migration guide: how to map `route_hint` -> `X-Redwood-Session` and how to test locally.
Olivia: Py SDK plan: add `Session` helper, update README, and include a warning log when old `route_hint` param is used. will include code sample in changelog and a short migration script.
Kai: TS SDK will mirror. include E2E tests that simulate backend eviction and assert 409 behavior when `required`.
Thao: Console: add a short modal when enabling affinity per-route: explain cost implications and best-practices (short sessions vs long-lived sessions). also add a "View pinned sessions" quick-link under the route metrics tab.
Zane: success metrics: look for >10% token cost reduction for KV-heavy chat workloads, no >5% increase in median latency, and <0.5% 409s in normal traffic after GA.
Raj: infra-wise: router needs to expose an API to list pinned sessions per worker for debugging, and a GC policy when a worker goes down. add a retention TTL config (default 30m) per tenant.
sre-bot: deploy note: routing-service v3.14.0 canary in 00:30 UTC. will start logging `session_affinity` telemetry when tenant flag enabled.
Olivia: will draft SDK PRs and a migration doc. link incoming.
Maria: thanks everyone — we'll sync after the canary to decide opt-in tenant list and telemetry sampling.
